trap.label: unless negativo
trap.wrong: Unless penalties do not rise, firms will keep cheating.
trap.right: Unless penalties rise, firms will keep cheating.
trap.why: Em português “a menos que não aumentem” pode soar natural. Em inglês, unless já contém a negação; evite not.

mcq.q: “___ the regulator cracked down, consumers would not be paying.” (past)
“___ it to act, prices would fall.”

fix.wrong: Had the regulator acted, consumers would not pay now.
fix.right: Had the regulator acted, consumers would not be paying now.

fix.wrong: Provided that firms to comply, fines stay low.
fix.right: Provided that firms comply, fines stay low.

fix.wrong: Unless the watchdog acts, will the ads continue.
fix.right: Unless the watchdog acts, the ads will continue.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Unless: “If penalties do not rise, firms will keep cheating.”
rewrite.answer: Unless penalties rise, firms will keep cheating.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Had: “If the regulator had acted, we would not be paying.”
rewrite.answer: Had the regulator acted, we would not be paying.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Provided: “Only if firms comply, fines stay low.” (Provided that…)
rewrite.answer: Provided that firms comply, fines stay low.
